keys.swarm.aura_blade_whirl_desc: You spin: your axe sweeps one full circle round you, then rests.
keys.swarm.aura_blade_whirl_ten: Steel Cyclone: a blade cyclone spins with you as you move.
keys.swarm.aura_shock_stomp_desc: You stomp and a shockwave rolls along the ground in a straight line ahead of you.
keys.swarm.aura_shock_stomp_ten: Earthbreaker: four shockwaves roll out in a cross.
